'''2015 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Nick (dropped) Thomas Whaley Reisch DS Senate Occupied''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Whaley]] at [[2015 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2), in the seat of [[Nick Reisch]], who dropped.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Senate Occupied]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-texas-mini-worlds/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013130941/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2015-texas-mini-worlds.html Internet Archive]
